threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver doesn’t say thank you. It’s like a rite of passage here, and you’re clearly not there yet.
Caught the N68 last night; a guy was loudly arguing with a mannequin he'd named 'Steve' for the entire journey. Only in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the Späti at 3 AM, I saw a group playing chess on the sidewalk, arguing about Queen's Gambit moves. That’s when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you enjoy a spontaneous open-air techno party under the U-Bahn tracks, while sipping a freshly brewed coffee from a nearby café.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they can navigate the BART delays like it’s a game, not a headache. Tourists panic; we just roll our eyes.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 14 just as a mariachi band hopped on at 24th St. Instant block party, but then a full-on debate erupted about the best taco spot nearby.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss how late shop owners stay open; it's not just the bars but the little bakeries too, sometimes until 2 AM for fresh bread.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their struggle to navigate the Mercat de la Llibertat without a map—locals zip through like they're on autopilot.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You keep trying to pay for your coffee with cash at the hipster cafes. They look at you like you just walked in from the 90s.
Last night on the 333, a guy argued with the driver over the fare while a woman sang Adele. Only in Brixton would you get that mix.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted my neighbor feeding a street cat while arguing with a pigeon—classic Neukölln, right? Only here you find harmony in the chaos.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg will you find a kebab shop that doubles as an art gallery, serving late-night snacks while showcasing local talent on the walls.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they say 'Civic Center' without flinching at the chaos, like it’s just another Tuesday.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 5 bus today during peak hours—it was standing room only and someone brought a karaoke machine. Only in the Tenderloin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists miss that the real vibe of Gràcia comes alive after dark—it's when the squares fill with locals, laughing and sharing tapas, not during the day.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they're new by the way they navigate through the streets, looking up at the buildings instead of watching where they're walking.
